text.en:
Upon Picking Up <special/> Special or <heavy/> Power Ammo:
Magazine gets overflowed to 200% of its regular capacity from reserves.

Activates even if stowed.

enhanced (
#e Magazine gets overflowed to 205-222% of its regular capacity.
)
text.zh-chs:
拾取 <special/> 特殊或 <heavy/> 重型弹药：
武器使用备弹过量装填至 200% 弹匣量。

武器收起时也可触发。

enhanced (
#e 过量装填至 205-222% 弹匣量
)
